title: 'UAP hedge' tweet responding to FT Alphaville article on financial risks of UAP disclosure
summary: Matthew Pines tells of 'UAP hedge' tweet responding to FT Alphaville article on financial risks of UAP disclosure, about c. 2020-2021 at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like I think I have a I had like a semi- tongue-in-cheek tweet like four or five years ago that's like, "What's your UAP hedge hashtag Bitcoin?" It was a response to this uh, like FT alpha article is talking about like financial stability risks associated with uh, UAPs disclosure, right?

plain: Matthew Pines, a guest on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says that around 2020 or 2021 he posted a half-joking tweet asking "What's your UAP hedge?" with the tag Bitcoin. UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's newer word for UFOs. He says he was answering an article on FT Alphaville, a finance blog of the Financial Times newspaper, about the risk that official disclosure of UFOs could shake the financial system.
